units.source_text: 所以，当背后忽然传来声音时，他这一惊非同小可。

en.t: So when a voice suddenly came from behind him, the shock he felt was no small thing.

units.source_text: 只觉得自己被打得落花流水。

en.t: He felt as if he had been beaten down completely.

units.source_text: 连惭愧羞耻的心情，也像蜻蜓翅膀着了火，悄无声息地缩成一团，变成了灰。

en.t: Even his feelings of shame and humiliation, like a dragonfly wing catching fire, silently shriveled into a knot and turned to ash.
